THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ("Agreement") dated as of December , 2014 ("Effective Date"), by ARBERN SUTPHIN PROPERTIES L.L.C., a New York limited liability company having an office at c/o Jonas Equities, Inc. 725 Church Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11218 (*Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon ("Owner's Building"), in Queens County within the City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 146-17 Archer Place, Jamaica, New York and known as Block 9994, Lot 38 on the Tax Map of the City and State of New York (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described by metes and bounds in Exhibit A annexed hereto ("Owner's Property"). WHEREAS, Owner is also the owner in fee of the land located in Queens County within the City and State of New York known as and by the street address 90-75 Sutphin Boulevard, Jamaica, New York and known as Block 9994 Lot 31 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described by metes and bounds in in Exhibit B annexed hereto ("Developer's Property") (when referring to Owner as the Owner as the Owner of the Developer's Property, Owner is sometimes herein referred to as "Developer"). Owmer and Developer are sometimes referred to herein as the "Parties". WHEREAS,there exist unused“Available Development Rights"(hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Owner's Property which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized on the Owner's Property as of the Effective Date. As used in this Agreement, the term "Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, Owner previously utilized the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Owner's Property and Developer's Property into a single zoning lot ("Single Zoning Lot") for the purpose of ensuring that the New Building's (as hereinafter defined) floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in section 12 -10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended (the "Zoning Resolution") complies with the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution; (28612521;2}

WHEREAS, in contemplated of the possible construction or alterations with respect to the existing building located on the Developer's Property ("Existing Building") or the construction of a new building thereon (said construction, additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein called the "New Building"), Owner intends to make available to Developer's Property, all Available Development Rights from the Owner's Property pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. As used in this Agreement, "Available Development Rights" shall mean all Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner's Property minus the Floor Area Development Rights now attributable to the building existing on Owner's Property as of the Effective Date (hereinafter defined as“Retained Development Rights"). Available Development Rights shall include any and all development rights resulting from any upward revision of the Floor Area Development Rights and any and all development rights and other benefits which may become available including additional Floor Area Development Rights resulting from a floor areabonus. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree asfollows: ARTICLEI TRANSFEROFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTSANDLIGHTANDAIREASEMENT Section 1.1  Owner, hereby transfers and reallocates all right, title and interest of and any successor and assign of the Owner in the Developer's Property ("Successor Owner") may utilize the Available Development Rights for any permitted purpose, including, without limitation the construction of the New Building. Owner, solely in its capacity as the owner of Owner's Property, shall retain all Retained Development Rights attributable to the building now existing on Owner's Property as the same exists on the Effective Date, and no Successor Owner shall have any rights with respect to any of the Retained Development Rights. Section 1.2Owner acknowledges that a Successor Owner may seek to either dispose of the Available Development Rights or acquire additional Floor Area Development Rights from any other source (hereinafter “Additional Floor Area Development Rights") so as to further increase the potential Floor Area of the New Building and Owner consents toDeveloper's disposition of the Available Development Rights or acquisition of such Additional Floor Area Development Rights and agrees that the Successor Owner may incorporate into the New Building any Additional Floor Area Development Rights which Successor Owner may hereinafter acquire, in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. Section 1.3.
